changes.cause: M1 passed a unit chord direction into the curvature expression, omitting the chord-length-squared factor from directional curvature demand.
changes.correction: M1 now passes the physical chord vector into q=e^T|II|e and the normal term; D9EndpointNeedScore computes max(q/8, |n.e|/4) with that chord. Each endpoint uses its own authority-supported sides and feature-join sides are reduced by maximum.
changes.verification: Source-level dimensional check: curvature has inverse-length units and q over the physical chord is dimensionless; the normal dot chord has length units. No build or test run was allowed.

changes.cause: The D9 diagnostic had one oversized test body and several multi-operation lines, making the fixture hard to review against the 80-line helper limit.
changes.correction: Split inventory, side filtering/scoring, edge scan, face classification/output, projection setup/binding, and summary generation into helpers; clang-format was applied only to the new D9 block.
changes.verification: Source-level function scan found every D9 helper and the test body at or below 80 lines; largest is D9MeasureFaces at 76 lines.

changes.cause: The elapsed deadline was not checked before M1 edge traversal or before M5 overlay/context work, so later work could begin after M3 consumed the limit.
changes.correction: Check the shared 600-second deadline at each M1 edge, M3 face, M5 edge, and after M5 overlay construction; report unvisited and unattempted counts separately.
changes.verification: Source-level control-flow review confirms M5 outer dispatch is skipped when M3 reaches the deadline and M5 rechecks before overlay and context creation.

changes.cause: The final JSON label said no numerical campaign was launched even though the diagnostic deliberately executes geometry queries.
changes.correction: Rename the field to production_workflow_launched=false, distinguishing diagnostic geometry calls from a production workflow launch.
changes.verification: Source inspection confirms the observed and unsupported-input summaries use the corrected field.

validation.clang_format: applied to the new D9 block only

primary_context_and_empty_csv.cause: Primary API review: WithParameterState returns shared_ptr<const PlanarReference>; new fixture context used a mutable pointer type. Also projection CSV could be empty when deadline prevented entering its helper.
primary_context_and_empty_csv.correction: Use const shared pointer contexts and write CSV schema before optional projection work; no production/gate change.

primary_projection_scope.cause: M5 asks cost of one projection; initial all-edge projection census ran after expensive M3 and could get no time, unnecessarily expanding the fixture.
primary_projection_scope.correction: Measure the first demanded edge once before the face census, and label single-sample scope, keeping total need-edge denominator and incomplete census explicit.
